$comment: Real-world numbers for stats.eurth.org, built by tools/build-snapshot.mjs. Each value is [value, year]. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run snapshot` and commit the result.
scope: The 193 member states of the United Nations, wherever a number is published.

world-bank.name: World Development Indicators
world-bank.attribution: World Development Indicators, The World Bank. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
world-bank.note: The World Bank gathers these series from the UN Population Division (World Population Prospects, World Urbanization Prospects), the International Comparison Program, the International Institute for Strategic Studies (The Military Balance), the IMF (Government Finance Statistics) and national statistical offices.

sipri.name: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database
sipri.licence: SIPRI's terms and conditions: one year of one series, used without charge under its fair-use policy
sipri.attribution: Information from the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) Military Expenditure Database, https://www.sipri.org/databases/milex, as published in the World Development Indicators.

over64.name: Population ages 65 and above (% of total population)

derived.growth: Average yearly real GDP growth over the ten newest years, compounded (at least eight years needed).
derived.density: population / area, people per square kilometre of land
derived.priceLevel: gdp / gdpPpp x 100: prices against the United States, where the United States is 100
derived.spendingPerSoldier: militarySpending / 100 x gdp / military, US dollars a year
